parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The balloon contains a volume of 12 m 3 of helium gas at a pressure of 110 kPa. The balloon is released and rises to a height h where the pressure of the gas is 52 kPa. The temperature and the mass of helium gas remain constant.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Calculate the volume of the helium gas at height h. volume = .................................................... m 3 [2]

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) At height h, the balloon has gained 120 kJ of energy in the gravitational potential store. The mass of the balloon is 2.5 kg. Calculate the height h. h = ..................................................... m [3]
